## ATTRIBUTION RULES

1. Cell runs both operations in sequence on a fresh per-cell workspace clone; every op postcondition must hold. Attribution = test id `CX-nnnnnn` (the id is emitted as a named check in the LogicTest run).
2. Cell blocked by an engine dialect gate is NOT COMPOSABLE on the real code path; attribution = the reason with the engine source reference (no test exists and none is possible without changing engine support).
3. For pairs of PLAN-kind ops (no dataset mutation) the runner additionally asserts order invariance: AB and BA leave identical dataset fingerprints.
4. For pairs involving TRANS-kind ops (masking / cleanup / audit / faker) the runner additionally re-executes the AB sequence on a second clone and asserts deterministic fingerprints.
